question: What is the highest eligible free rate for K-12 students in the schools in Alameda County?
sql: SELECT `free meal count (k-12)` / `enrollment (k-12)` FROM frpm WHERE `county name` = 'Alameda' ORDER BY (cast(`free meal count (k-12)` AS REAL) / `enrollment (k-12)`) DESC LIMIT 1
evidence: Eligible free rate for K-12 = `free meal count (k-12)` / `enrollment (k-12)`;

sql: SELECT cast(sum(CASE WHEN cards.convertedmanacost = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / count(cards.id) FROM cards INNER JOIN SETS ON SETS.code = cards.setcode WHERE SETS.name = 'Coldsnap'
evidence: converted mana cost of 7 refers to convertedmanacost = 7; card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'; percentage = DIVidE(SUM(convertedmanacost = 7), SUM(convertedmanacost))*100;

question: Calculate the percentage whereby Hamilton was not at the 1st track of the the f1 circuit since 2010.

question: How much faster in percentage is the champion than the driver who finished the race last in the 2008 Australian Grand Prix?
sql: WITH time_in_seconds AS ( SELECT results.positionorder, CASE WHEN results.positionorder = 1 THEN (cast(substr(results.time, 1, 1) AS REAL) * 3600) + (cast(substr(results.time, 3, 2) AS REAL) * 60) + cast(substr(results.time, 6) AS REAL) ELSE cast(substr(results.time, 2) AS REAL) END AS time_seconds FROM results INNER JOIN races ON results.raceid = races.raceid WHERE races.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND results.time IS NOT NULL AND races.year = 2008 ), champion_time AS ( SELECT time_seconds FROM time_in_seconds WHERE positionorder = 1), last_driver_incremental AS ( SELECT time_seconds FROM time_in_seconds WHERE positionorder = (SELECT max(positionorder) FROM time_in_seconds) ) SELECT (cast((SELECT time_seconds FROM last_driver_incremental) AS REAL) * 100) / (SELECT time_seconds + (SELECT time_seconds FROM last_driver_incremental) FROM champion_time)

question: What is the average time in seconds of champion for each year, before year 1975?

,    `circuitid` integer PRIMARY KEY -- example: [2, 3]
    `circuitref` text --  circuit reference name, example: [sepang, bahrain]
    `name` text --
    `location` text -- example: [Kuala Lumpur, Sakhir]
    `country` text -- example: [Malaysia, Bahrain]
    `lat` real --  latitude, example: [2.76083, 26.0325]
    `lng` real --  longitude, example: [101.738, 50.5106]
    `alt` integer --
    `url` text --
    CONSTRAINT fk_circuits_circuitId FOREIGN KEY (`circuitId`) REFERENCES `pitStops` (`lap`)
);

CREATE TABLE `constructors` (
,    `constructorid` integer PRIMARY KEY -- example: [147, 39]
    `constructorref` text --  constructor reference name, example: [mclaren, bmw_sauber]
    `name` text -- example: [AFM, AGS]
    `nationality` text -- example: [British, German]
    `url` text --
);

CREATE TABLE `drivers` (
,    `driverid` integer PRIMARY KEY -- example: [452, 625]
    `driverref` text --  driver reference name, example: [hamilton, heidfeld]
    `number` integer -- example: [44, 6]
    `code` text -- example: [HAM, HEI]
    `forename` text -- example: [Lewis, Nick]
    `surname` text -- example: [Hamilton, Heidfeld]
    `dob` date --  date of birth, example: [1985-01-07, 1977-05-10]
    `nationality` text -- example: [British, German]
    `url` text --
);

CREATE TABLE `seasons` (
,    `year` integer PRIMARY KEY --  race id, example: [1950, 1951]
    `url` text --
);

CREATE TABLE `races` (
,    `raceid` integer PRIMARY KEY -- example: [837, 833]
    `year` integer -- example: [2009, 2008]
    `round` integer -- example: [1, 2]
    `circuitid` integer -- example: [1, 2]
    `name` text -- example: [Australian Grand Prix, Malaysian Grand Prix]
    `date` date -- example: [2009-03-29, 2009-04-05]
    `time` text -- example: [06:00:00, 09:00:00]
    `url` text --
    CONSTRAINT fk_races_circuitid FOREIGN KEY (`circuitid`) REFERENCES `circuits` (`circuitid`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_races_year FOREIGN KEY (`year`) REFERENCES `seasons` (`year`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_races_circuitId FOREIGN KEY (`circuitId`) REFERENCES `pitStops` (`lap`)
);

CREATE TABLE `constructorresults` (
,    `constructorresultsid` integer PRIMARY KEY -- example: [1, 2]
    `raceid` integer -- example: [18, 19]
    `constructorid` integer -- example: [1, 2]
    `points` real -- example: [14.0, 8.0]
    `status` text -- example: [D]
    CONSTRAINT fk_constructorresults_constructorid FOREIGN KEY (`constructorid`) REFERENCES `constructors` (`constructorid`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_constructorresults_raceid FOREIGN KEY (`raceid`) REFERENCES `races` (`raceid`)
);

CREATE TABLE `constructorstandings` (
,    `constructorstandingsid` integer PRIMARY KEY -- example: [1, 2]
    `raceid` integer -- example: [18, 19]
    `constructorid` integer -- example: [1, 2]
    `points` real -- example: [14.0, 8.0]
    `position` integer -- example: [1, 3]
    `positiontext` text -- example: [1, 3]
    `wins` integer -- example: [1, 0]
    CONSTRAINT fk_constructorstandings_constructorid FOREIGN KEY (`constructorid`) REFERENCES `constructors` (`constructorid`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_constructorstandings_raceid FOREIGN KEY (`raceid`) REFERENCES `races` (`raceid`)
);

CREATE TABLE `driverstandings` (
,    `driverstandingsid` integer PRIMARY KEY -- example: [1, 2]
    `raceid` integer --  constructor reference name, example: [18, 19]
    `driverid` integer -- example: [1, 2]
    `points` real -- example: [10.0, 8.0]
    `position` integer -- example: [1, 2]
    `positiontext` text -- example: [1, 2]
    `wins` integer -- example: [1, 0]
    CONSTRAINT fk_driverstandings_driverid FOREIGN KEY (`driverid`) REFERENCES `drivers` (`driverid`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_driverstandings_raceid FOREIGN KEY (`raceid`) REFERENCES `races` (`raceid`)
);

CREATE TABLE `laptimes` (
,    `raceid` integer PRIMARY KEY -- example: [1, 2]
    `driverid` integer -- example: [1, 2]
    `lap` integer -- example: [1, 2]
    `position` integer -- example: [13, 12]
    `time` text -- example: [1:49.088, 1:33.740]
    `milliseconds` integer -- example: [109088, 93740]
    CONSTRAINT fk_laptimes_driverid FOREIGN KEY (`driverid`) REFERENCES `drivers` (`driverid`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_laptimes_raceid FOREIGN KEY (`raceid`) REFERENCES `races` (`raceid`)
);

,    `raceid` integer PRIMARY KEY -- example: [841, 842]
    `driverid` integer -- example: [1, 2]
    `stop` integer -- example: [1, 2]
    `lap` integer -- example: [16, 36]
    `time` text -- example: [17:28:24, 17:59:29]
    `duration` text -- example: [23.227, 23.199]
    `milliseconds` integer -- example: [23227, 23199]
    CONSTRAINT fk_pitstops_driverid FOREIGN KEY (`driverid`) REFERENCES `drivers` (`driverid`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_pitstops_raceid FOREIGN KEY (`raceid`) REFERENCES `races` (`raceid`)
);

CREATE TABLE `qualifying` (
,    `qualifyid` integer PRIMARY KEY -- example: [1, 2]
    `raceid` integer -- example: [18, 19]
    `driverid` integer -- example: [1, 9]
    `constructorid` integer -- example: [1, 2]

    `position` integer -- example: [1, 2]
    `q1` text --  qualifying 1, example: [1:26.572, 1:26.103]
    `q2` text --  qualifying 2, example: [1:25.187, 1:25.315]
    `q3` text --  qualifying 3, example: [1:26.714, 1:26.869]
    CONSTRAINT fk_qualifying_constructorid FOREIGN KEY (`constructorid`) REFERENCES `constructors` (`constructorid`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_qualifying_driverid FOREIGN KEY (`driverid`) REFERENCES `drivers` (`driverid`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_qualifying_raceid FOREIGN KEY (`raceid`) REFERENCES `races` (`raceid`)
);

CREATE TABLE `status` (
,    `statusid` integer PRIMARY KEY -- example: [1, 2]
    `status` text -- example: [Finished, Disqualified]
);

CREATE TABLE `results` (
,    `resultid` integer PRIMARY KEY -- example: [1, 2]
    `raceid` integer -- example: [18, 19]
    `driverid` integer -- example: [1, 2]
    `constructorid` integer -- example: [1, 2]
    `number` integer -- example: [22, 3]
    `grid` integer -- example: [1, 5]
    `position` integer -- example: [1, 2]
    `positiontext` text -- example: [1, 2]
    `positionorder` integer -- example: [1, 2]
    `points` real -- example: [10.0, 8.0]
    `laps` integer -- example: [58, 57]
    `time` text -- example: [1:34:50.616, +5.478]
    `milliseconds` integer -- example: [5690616, 5696094]
    `fastestlap` integer -- example: [39, 41]
    `rank` integer -- example: [2, 3]
    `fastestlaptime` text -- example: [1:27.452, 1:27.739]
    `fastestlapspeed` text -- example: [218.300, 217.586]
    `statusid` integer -- example: [1, 11]
    CONSTRAINT fk_results_statusid FOREIGN KEY (`statusid`) REFERENCES `status` (`statusid`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_results_constructorid FOREIGN KEY (`constructorid`) REFERENCES `constructors` (`constructorid`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_results_driverid FOREIGN KEY (`driverid`) REFERENCES `drivers` (`driverid`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_results_raceid FOREIGN KEY (`raceid`) REFERENCES `races` (`raceid`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_results_points FOREIGN KEY (`points`) REFERENCES `driverStandings` (`points`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_results_position FOREIGN KEY (`position`) REFERENCES `driverStandings` (`position`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_results_positionOrder FOREIGN KEY (`positionOrder`) REFERENCES `driverStandings` (`position`)

question: Which top 20 driver created the shortest lap time ever record in a Formula_1 race? Please give them full names.
sql: WITH lap_times_in_seconds AS (SELECT driverid, (CASE WHEN substr(TIME, 1, instr(TIME, ':') - 1) <> '' THEN cast(substr(TIME, 1, instr(TIME, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN substr(TIME, instr(TIME, ':') + 1, instr(TIME, '.') - instr(TIME, ':') - 1) <> '' THEN cast(substr(TIME, instr(TIME, ':') + 1, instr(TIME, '.') - instr(TIME, ':') - 1) AS REAL) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN substr(TIME, instr(TIME, '.') + 1) <> '' THEN cast(substr(TIME, instr(TIME, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000 ELSE 0 END) AS time_in_seconds FROM laptimes) SELECT drivers.forename, drivers.surname, t1.driverid FROM (SELECT driverid, min(time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds FROM lap_times_in_seconds GROUP BY driverid) AS t1 INNER JOIN drivers ON t1.driverid = drivers.driverid ORDER BY t1.min_time_in_seconds ASC LIMIT 20

question: Please list the lap records for the circuits in Italy.
sql: WITH fastest_lap_times AS (SELECT results.raceid, results.fastestlaptime, (cast(substr(results.fastestlaptime, 1, instr(results.fastestlaptime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + (cast(substr(results.fastestlaptime, instr(results.fastestlaptime, ':') + 1, instr(results.fastestlaptime, '.') - instr(results.fastestlaptime, ':') - 1) AS REAL)) + (cast(substr(results.fastestlaptime, instr(results.fastestlaptime, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) AS time_in_seconds FROM results WHERE results.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL ) SELECT results.fastestlaptime AS lap_record FROM results INNER JOIN races ON results.raceid = races.raceid INNER JOIN circuits ON races.circuitid = circuits.circuitid INNER JOIN (SELECT min(fastest_lap_times.time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds FROM fastest_lap_times INNER JOIN races ON fastest_lap_times.raceid = races.raceid INNER JOIN circuits ON races.circuitid = circuits.circuitid WHERE circuits.country = 'Italy' ) AS t4 ON (cast(substr(results.fastestlaptime, 1, instr(results.fastestlaptime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + (cast(substr(results.fastestlaptime, instr(results.fastestlaptime, ':') + 1, instr(results.fastestlaptime, '.') - instr(results.fastestlaptime, ':') - 1) AS REAL)) + (cast(substr(results.fastestlaptime, instr(results.fastestlaptime, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) = t4.min_time_in_seconds LIMIT 1

question: In Scotland Premier League, which away team won the most during the 2010 season?
sql: SELECT teaminfo.team_long_name FROM league AS leaguedata INNER JOIN MATCH AS matchdata ON leaguedata.id = matchdata.league_id INNER JOIN team AS teaminfo ON matchdata.away_team_api_id = teaminfo.team_api_id WHERE leaguedata.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND matchdata.season = '2009/2010' AND matchdata.away_team_goal - matchdata.home_team_goal > 0 GROUP BY matchdata.away_team_api_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
evidence: Final result should return the team.team_long_name; Scotland Premier league refers to league.name = 'Scotland Premier league'; away team refers to away_team_api_id; away team that won the most refers to MAX(SUBTRACT(away_team_goal, home_team_goal) > 0); 2010 season refers to season = '2009/2010'; won the most refers to MAX(COUNT(*));

question: At present, calculate for the player's age who have a sprint speed of no less than 97 between 2013 to 2015.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT datetime() - player.birthday age FROM player_attributes INNER JOIN player ON player_attributes.player_api_id = player.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y',player_attributes.`date`) >= '2013' AND strftime('%Y',player_attributes.`date`) <= '2015' AND player_attributes.sprint_speed >= 97
evidence: players age at present = SUBTRACT((dateTIME(), birthday)); sprint speed of no less than 97 refers to sprint_speed >= 97; between 2013 to 2015 refers to YEAR(date) >= '2013' AND YEAR(date) <= '2015';

question: Calculate the percentage of players who prefer left foot, who were born between 1987 and 1992.
sql: SELECT cast(count(CASE WHEN player_attributes.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN player.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / count(player.id) percent FROM player INNER JOIN player_attributes ON player.player_api_id = player_attributes.player_api_id WHERE substr(player.birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992'

question: List the top 5 leagues in ascending order of the number of goals made in all seasons combined.
sql: SELECT league.name, sum(MATCH.home_team_goal) + sum(MATCH.away_team_goal) FROM league INNER JOIN MATCH ON league.id = MATCH.league_id GROUP BY league.name ORDER BY sum(MATCH.home_team_goal) + sum(MATCH.away_team_goal) ASC LIMIT 5

question: Who has the highest average finishing rate between the highest and shortest football player?
sql: SELECT a FROM ( SELECT avg(finishing) RESULT, 'Max' a FROM player INNER JOIN player_attributes ON player.player_api_id = player_attributes.player_api_id WHERE player.height = ( SELECT max(height) FROM player ) UNION SELECT avg(finishing) RESULT, 'Min' a FROM player INNER JOIN player_attributes ON player.player_api_id = player_attributes.player_api_id WHERE player.height = ( SELECT min(height) FROM player ) ) ORDER BY RESULT DESC LIMIT 1

sql: SELECT count(MATCH.id) FROM league INNER JOIN MATCH ON league.id = MATCH.league_id WHERE league.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga' AND substr(MATCH.`date`, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10'

question: Give the name of the league had the most matches in the 2008/2009 season?
sql: SELECT league.name FROM league JOIN MATCH ON league.id = MATCH.league_id WHERE MATCH.season = '2008/2009' GROUP BY league.name HAVING count(MATCH.id) = (SELECT max(match_count) FROM (SELECT count(MATCH.id) AS match_count FROM MATCH WHERE MATCH.season = '2008/2009' GROUP BY MATCH.league_id))

,    `event_id` text PRIMARY KEY -- example: [rec0Si5cQ4rJRVzd6, rec0akZnLLpGUloLH]
    `event_name` text -- example: [March Meeting]
    `event_date` text -- example: [2020-03-10T12:00:00, 2020-01-14T09:30:00]
    `type` text -- example: [Meeting, Election]
    `notes` text --
    `location` text -- example: [MU 215]
    `status` text -- example: [Open, Planning]
    CONSTRAINT fk_event_status FOREIGN KEY (`status`) REFERENCES `budget` (`event_status`)
);

CREATE TABLE `major` (
,    `major_id` text PRIMARY KEY -- example: [rec06DF6vZ1CyPKpc, rec09LedkREyskCNv]
    `major_name` text --
    `department` text --
    `college` text --
);

CREATE TABLE `zip_code` (
,    `zip_code` integer PRIMARY KEY -- example: [501, 544]
    `type` text -- example: [Unique, Standard]
    `city` text -- example: [Holtsville, Adjuntas]
    `county` text -- example: [Suffolk County, Adjuntas Municipio]
    `state` text -- example: [New York, Puerto Rico]
    `short_state` text -- example: [NY, PR]
);

CREATE TABLE `attendance` (
,    `link_to_event` text PRIMARY KEY -- example: [rec2N69DMcrqN9PJC, rec5XDvJLyxDsGZWc]
    `link_to_member` text -- example: [recD078PnS3x2doBe, recP6DJPyi5donvXL]
    CONSTRAINT fk_attendance_link_to_member FOREIGN KEY (`link_to_member`) REFERENCES `member` (`member_id`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_attendance_link_to_event FOREIGN KEY (`link_to_event`) REFERENCES `event` (`event_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `budget` (
,    `budget_id` text PRIMARY KEY -- example: [rec0QmEc3cSQFQ6V2, rec1bG6HSft7XIvTP]
    `category` text -- example: [Advertisement, Food]
    `spent` real -- example: [67.81, 121.14]
    `remaining` real -- example: [7.19, 28.86]
    `amount` integer -- example: [75, 150]
    `event_status` text -- example: [Closed, Open]
    `link_to_event` text -- example: [recI43CzsZ0Q625ma, recggMW2eyCYceNcy]
    CONSTRAINT fk_budget_link_to_event FOREIGN KEY (`link_to_event`) REFERENCES `event` (`event_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `expense` (
,    `expense_id` text PRIMARY KEY -- example: [rec017x6R3hQqkLAo, rec1nIjoZKTYayqZ6]
    `expense_description` text -- example: [Post Cards, Posters, Water, Cookies]
    `expense_date` text -- example: [2019-08-20, 2019-10-08]
    `cost` real -- example: [122.06, 20.2]
    `approved` text -- example: [true]
    `link_to_member` text -- example: [rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v, recro8T1MPMwRadVH]
    `link_to_budget` text -- example: [recvKTAWAFKkVNnXQ, recy8KY5bUdzF81vv]
    CONSTRAINT fk_expense_link_to_member FOREIGN KEY (`link_to_member`) REFERENCES `member` (`member_id`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_expense_link_to_budget FOREIGN KEY (`link_to_budget`) REFERENCES `budget` (`budget_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `income` (
,    `income_id` text PRIMARY KEY -- example: [rec0s9ZrO15zhzUeE, rec7f5XMQZexgtQJo]
    `date_received` text -- example: [2019-10-17, 2019-09-04]
    `amount` integer -- example: [50, 200]
    `source` text -- example: [Dues, Fundraising]
    `notes` text --
    `link_to_member` text -- example: [reccW7q1KkhSKZsea, recTjHY5xXhvkCdVT]
    CONSTRAINT fk_income_link_to_member FOREIGN KEY (`link_to_member`) REFERENCES `member` (`member_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `member` (
,    `member_id` text PRIMARY KEY -- example: [rec1x5zBFIqoOuPW8, rec280Sk7o31iG0Tx]
    `first_name` text -- example: [Angela, Grant]
    `last_name` text -- example: [Sanders, Gilmour]
    `email` text -- example: [angela.sanders@lpu.edu, grant.gilmour@lpu.edu]
    `position` text -- example: [Member, Inactive]
    `t_shirt_size` text -- example: [Medium, X-Large]
    `phone` text -- example: [(651) 928-4507, 403-555-1310]
    `zip` integer -- example: [55108, 29440]
    `link_to_major` text -- example: [recxK3MHQFbR9J5uO, rec7BxKpjJ7bNph3O]
    CONSTRAINT fk_member_zip FOREIGN KEY (`zip`) REFERENCES `zip_code` (`zip_code`)
    CONSTRAINT fk_member_link_to_major FOREIGN KEY (`link_to_major`) REFERENCES `major` (`major_id`)
);
